data.one_liner: Https Certificate pinning for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Checks equality between known SHA-1 or SHA-256 fingerprints and the target server's certificate fingerprint. It integrates with Dio via an interceptor, provides a secure http client, or can be called directly for custom implementations.
use_when: You need to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks by validating server certificate fingerprints.
You are using Dio or the http package and want to add certificate pinning.
avoid_when: You do not control or regularly update your server's SSL/TLS certificates, as pin changes will break the app.
You require advanced certificate validation beyond simple SHA-1/SHA-256 fingerprint matching.
strengths: Provides built-in interceptors and clients for popular networking libraries like Dio and http.
Supports checking certificates via SHA-1 and SHA-256 fingerprints.
weaknesses: Requires manual updating of certificate fingerprints in the app when server certificates rotate.
Limited documentation on platform-specific native setup or edge cases.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency and configuring allowed SHA fingerprints along with OpenSSL commands to extract the certificate fingerprint.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a basic HTTP client without the requirement for certificate pinning.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a powerful HTTP client for interceptors and global configurations, though pinning requires an external plugin like this one.
